note: A value is never changed after results exist; a revised value is added beside the original with the reason. The small evaluation has fewer fridges than evaluation_fridges_min, so every verdict is provisional.

recall.basis: an earlier real-package run of the same model reached 0.50-0.58; a modest improvement is asked

false_recognition.basis: at most about one wrong candidate in three on the confirmation screen

fix_count_mean.basis: more than about six edits per scan is more work than typing

comparison_rule.variant_better_if: paired bootstrap 95% interval over scenes excludes 0 and the point estimate is at least the margin
